name: Supriya
words: We spent 3 days including New Year's Eve at Aikkya. Their place is ideally located with great views, peace and quiet. Our room was simply yet beautifully decorated and was very clean. We liked the fact that their cottages are built with local building techniques, are sustainable and still have the modern amenities and comforts. We especially loved the common lounge/dining area with it's wood burning stove. It's the ideal place to chill, get to meet the other guests, eat and drink.  Shivani and Avijeet go to great lengths to cater to the tastes of each of their guests, cooking different cuisines and offering variety. We had some delicious meals and got to taste an authentic Kumaoni spread.  At the end of our stay, we left knowing that we will be back.

name: Amartya Sengupta
words: The homestay run by Abhijeet and Shivani is home away from home. Their food, the rooms, the entire property is just somewhere I wanna stay for a long time. I have recommended this place to many and will definitely visit again for more experience.

name: Tamali B
words:
Our only regret on this trip was just having 2 days to spend in this beautiful place.

Aikkya is truly a one-of-a-kind experience in the mountains - the perfect blend of tastefully done rooms and furnishings, cozy spaces to relax in, great walking and hiking trails, breathtaking sunsets, a huge variety of meals featuring fresh produce, amazing cocktails...and above all, amazing hospitality. Shivani and Avijeet are wonderful hosts who made us and Axl feel truly welcomed in every space of their property.

Cannot wait to be back soon!

name: Parama Bhattacharya
words:
I visited Aikkya Farms in Sheetla last year and I have not stopped thinking about it since. Eight months have passed and some part of that place still visits me every single day. The peace you feel there is difficult to put into words. No horns, no crowds, just the grandest mountain ranges standing quietly in front of you and clean cold air that makes you breathe properly after years.

What makes this place truly special is the couple who built it. The husband is an artist, and it shows in every single corner. Nothing here is accidental. The paintings, the design, the smallest details in every nook, all done with his own hands. You keep stopping mid-walk because something catches your eye and you realise someone thought about that exact spot. It is unbelievable that a place like this actually exists, and I know that sounds emotional, but that is genuinely how it feels when you are standing there.

And it is a real partnership. While he takes care of the art and the soul of the place, his wife runs the operations with a dedication you rarely see anywhere. Together they have created something that feels less like a property and more like a labour of love you have been invited into.

The food deserves its own paragraph. Simple, fresh, pahadi style cooking that tastes like someone's home, not a hotel kitchen. I remember those meals more clearly than restaurants I ate at last week.

I came back a different person and stayed that way for months. It is not a holiday, it is a reset button for your mind. I am going back in November and honestly, if I could stay there forever I would not complain.

If you are tired of hill stations that have turned into markets, go here. Go before everyone finds out.

name: Rajarshi Chakravertee
words:
Topping up: it’s my second visit after three years and it still holds the same amazing reputation as it had while I visited here the last time! Sustaining the same hospitality consistently is tough and they are doing it seamlessly.

Aikkya Farms.... Where to start and where to end... Quite tough.... Just because every praise would be an understatement.

Well just the last thing to begin with.. i booked 2 nights and then kept extending and ended up staying 5 nights amid nature and the so well curated space for living amid mother nature.

Aikkya is an experience, cannot compare. Hosts, they are just amazing, be it Shivani or Avijeet. Avijeet was at the property and trust me, his passion reflects not just in Aikkya stay, but on his daily interaction as well. He does amazing food and cocktails, all he needs is your preference and taste buds' understanding and you are sorted. Humble, down to earth with a super high level of creative mind has definitely led to the conception of Aikkya farms.

It's gonna be my retreat again and again, and i strongly recommend it to people who love to live in peace and solitude for a few days  to unwind/relax/chill and up for some great talks and stories... But if you are a person who needs anything more than peace and tranquility, or wanna be in the chaos even after moving out of the city chaos for a few days, or heavy parties or shopping and market, well, this might not really be your place.

I had seen all the 4 accommodation options available here and all are unique in their own way. Japanese and Scandinavian concept. I was put up in the A Frame of Mind accommodation, and every morning was a bliss to wake up to. Well, i might have been able to just say 1% of what my eyes saw and i experienced.

I highly recommend this place for travelers!!

name: Ameeshi
words:
TL;DR: warm, peaceful, best hosting, best food, beautiful, highly recommend, 10/10.

I spent about ten days at Aikkya, and it felt like a small blessing tucked into the hills. I had come for a creative retreat nearby, and Avijeet — Aikkya’s co-creator and host — would pick me up and drop me off every day, often at a moment’s notice. It was just one of many examples of how thoughtful and present he is as a host.

Aikkya doubles as a restaurant, and honestly, it became my favourite in the area. Avijeet loves cooking, and you can tell; every dish, whether Kumaoni or Japanese, is made with fresh ingredients and real care. I ended up eating far more than I usually do simply because everything was that good. He also loves mixology, and fixed up some truly delicious cocktails.

The space itself is so intentionally put together. Every stone, every thrifted piece of furniture, each restored room carries warmth, with sustainable materials, soft light, and beautiful textures everywhere. Avijeet and Shivani built this place slowly and lovingly.

The winter sun pours in from 9 to 5 (the only way to do a 9 to 5), and the sunroom became my favourite spot — warm in the day, perfect for sunsets, and a cozy screening room at night. I didn’t feel the need to leave the property much; it was enough just being here.

Aikkya is also an orchard, and even in winter, galgal lemon, malta, and wild persimmon thrived, while the wine-coloured sehar bel curtained around the space. I have to come back for the flowering and fruit seasons.

And the animals were my favourite — Julie and Motu (the sweetest indies) loitered around, and Shifu and Bolt(u), their kids, as Avijeet calls them, guarded their enclosure like it’s their kingdom. I would wake up to birdsong, and watch blue magpies and colourful barbets, among many others, dart around. The place feels alive in a gentle, peaceful way.

Aikkya gave me one of the calmest, most grounding stays I’ve had in a long time. I truly didn’t want to leave.

name: Devika Vohra
words:
Aikkya Farms is a wonderful place to experience! The property has a peaceful charm and a warm, welcoming vibe. It’s extremely pet-friendly — I visited with my pup Daffy, and he had the best time exploring and playing around freely.

Shivani and Avijeet were such wonderful hosts — attentive, kind, and genuinely passionate about creating a great experience for both guests and pets. Highly recommend Aikkya Farms if you’re looking for a relaxing, pet-friendly getaway!

name: Anjali Chaudhary
words:
Tucked away in a quiet little corner near Mukteshwar, Aikkya felt like it was made for people who want to disappear from the world for a bit—but in the best way possible. The moment I reached, it felt like time slowed down. No honking, no chaos—just clean air, the sound of rustling trees, and that deep silence you can actually feel.

The cottages were earthy and beautifully designed—minimal yet warm. It didn’t feel like a commercial resort at all. It felt like someone had built it with heart. I spent my mornings sipping coffee while looking at the hills and my evenings sitting around a bonfire, talking to strangers who didn’t feel like strangers for long.

The food? Honest and homely. Freshly made, no frills, just flavour. Everything was cooked with local produce, and you could taste the difference.

But what truly stayed with me was the energy of the place. It wasn’t just a stay—it felt like therapy. Aikkya has this stillness that makes you slow down, breathe deeper, and think clearer.

If you're ever feeling burnt out or just want to reconnect—with nature, or maybe with yourself—I’d say don’t think twice. Just go.

name: Preeti Rajinder Johar
words: I am the sorts who would rarely review anything or anyone... But this was an exceptional experience and hence this review is also an exception. I happened to stay in one of the cottages - wabi or sabi here .. it was just what I wanted and needed.  It is not only the choice of the location but what the hosts have done to the whole place that is mind-blowing. Despite the maddening crowd thronging hills... This place had the peace, the solitude, the calm and quietness, nestled amidst the jungle, the place itself is a piece of art... The food served here is delicious, fresh and healthy...and if you are lucky you can request and get amazing cocktails too.

name: Preeti Mehta
words:
Place undoubtedly is very pretty endowed with natural beauty  u wake up with chirping sounds of birds amazing sunsets place has its own rustic charm but real jewels r the young enthusiastic motivated owners Shivani n Avijeet . They go n extra mile to maintain high standards of the place they are so approachable , enthusiastic n motivated . Avijeet even wore chefs hat one afternoon to dish out the yummiest Asian meal for us . Thank you staff Neeraj , Shekhar n Deeoak . My kids would hv loved to take the friendly dogs Chotu Moti Julie n beautiful cows Soni n Ganga
Shivani ur a sweetheart will come again n Kudos to u guys ♥️♥️

name: Smriti Parikh
words: This beautiful stay nestled in the hilly forest area is the perfect place to hit pause and recover. The hosts, Shivani and Avijeet, are warm and make this place feel like home. Every detail, in the rooms and the common areas, is meticulously put together by the two of them. To add to the charm, you get the company of Julie, Motu and Bagheera who fill the heart up with joy. The food and coffee was also tasty, and the cocktails made by Avijeet are a must try. We stayed during monsoon and could explore several short and long hikes around the area.

name: Ann Van Spaendonk
words:
Beautiful place in nature, with fantastic views over the hills. Rooms are spacious and beautiful decorated, with a lot of charm, spread out over the property!  Hosts do everything to make your stay as comfortable as can be!
If you want relax in a green environment, this is the place to be!!

name: Anish De
words: Shivani and Avijeet are amazing hosts, as is the food and Avijeet' cocktails.  I went in with no real expectations, and came back wanting to go back as soon as I can. It is a very different experience from anything I have had before

name: Sarika Baheti
words: Amazing food & hospitality! Just the kind of peaceful space we were looking for a vacation in solitude! 😇

name: Gurleen Bhasin
words: Excellent experience here at Aikkya. Beautiful bird song, yummy food and magical sunsets.

name: Troy Chakraborty
words:
Aikkya farm and Home Stay- I would rather call it HOME than a HOMESTAY because that's exactly how you feel at Aikkya. Located in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand, a place called Seetla (near Mukhteshwar), this property is a slice of heaven on earth. Super Hosts Avijeet and Shivani and their freidly staff will never let you feel out of place with their warm hospitality. The property itself is a piece of art crafted and designed by Avijeet and Shivani themselves.
mesmerizing sunsets, the breathtaking view of the hills will take you to another dimension altogether.
if you are a pet lover, then this property is pet friendly where you can bring along your furry companion. Dont forget to meet and spend time with Shifu, Boltu, Motu and Julie, who are the furry hosts and souls of Aikkya.
delicous homestyle food ranging from Indian to Thai cuisines made by chefs and Avijeet himself is something you will remember forever. And if you are cocktail lover, do try special cocktails specially curated by Avijeet(owner) himself and I can bet you it's of another level altogether.
Do not miss out on trail walking, waterfalls, Kapileshwar temple (1200 years old temple) and other beautiful locations all within an hour drive from Aikkya. While you are there, do try the Pizzas at "Awaara Pizzeria" a small pizza joint just 10 mins away from the property, they make some amazing pizzas and mocktails.
How to reach the place:
nearest railway station is Kathgodam and from there its just 2 and half hours drive to Aikkya.
Nearest Airport is Pantnagar and from there its a 3 hours drive to the property.
if you are really looking for a short getaway alone or with your loved ones, Aikkya will do all justice to you.
Super property and super hosts.

name: Priyanka Chakraborty
words: Out of the world location arrangement place and the Hosts! I can’t get my mind out if it ever since I have returned. I wish both Avijeet and Shivani my best of wishes and loads of love they have put in their heart and soul to it and it reflects! Must must visit!

name: Avadhesh Kumar Singh
words: Rooms are artistic, cosy and quaint at the same time. Views are amazing, specially the sunset. We loved the Kumaoni delicacies. The hosts, Avijeet and Shivani are a joy to converse with. Cocktails by Avijeet are a must try; simply outstanding and out of the box.

name: Charu Rawat
words: Lovely host . Awesome food and amazing view. Spent some quality time with friends away from city’s hustling life. Cocktails , mocktails and farm fresh juice is a must try. 👍🏻

name: Tanushree Gupta
words:
This place feels like home. We spent a lot of time enjoying simple things like walking, hiking, playing Pictionary etc. All the things that we skip doing in our mechanical city life. The Kumaoni meal is a must try.

Avijeet and Shivani are “Monica 2.0” when it comes to hosting. They are the best.

PS: Do try the cocktails by Avijeet. It’s an experience you will never find anywhere else in the world.

name: Niky Desai
words:
Shivani and Avijeet
You have created magic ...
Less is more...
Beautiful place .. perfect weather ...
Pulsing with energy ...
Kind and loving and generous team
In love with your entire team..
Clean light and finger licking  home food ..
Lovely lounge area
Could spend the whole day having Coffees and Cocktails ...
Bon fire with music
Lovely collection of books ...
Beautiful aesthetics of the rooms
Wabi - sabi rooms ... Beautiful
Neat and clean rooms ...
Small small  details everywhere ...
Personal touch ...
Breathtaking views ...
The air , the sunsets , the treks , connect to the nature ..
Kids learned  and explored so much with the nature
Thank you for everything..
Gratitude..

name: Bhuvan Verma
words: Avijeet and Shivani have created a paradise in hills. Loved the miniature collection and art pieces, loved the music instrument collection, the birds doing the morning and evening rituals, the flower n fruit trees around...unique cocktails made here, pahadi and thai food, serene room and views, the dogs cuddling you, the warm sun and the cool breeze ....endless and boudless self care you can do once at aikkya...go live the experience.

name: Melissa Goodwin
words: We stayed at Aikkya Farms for a week and could've stayed for a lifetime. Avijeet was an all around host, making sure we were comfortable, well fed, and reaping the benefits of the sacred space we were in. It was a wonderful space to experience everything that Uttarakhand had to offer from nature, to local cuisine and culture. We felt part of the community and not just like visitors or tourists. Avijeet and Shivani have curated an oasis on the mountain and their exceptional artistry, taste, and attention to tradition are felt throughout the property and in the rooms. Very excited to see how their property and vision grow!

name: Navya Sharma
words:
My family and I recently had the pleasure of staying at Aikkya Farms for a week, and it was an absolutely delightful experience from start to finish. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed by the warm staff and hosts. The property exuded a sense of tranquility and rustic Kumaoni charm, providing the perfect setting for a relaxing getaway. Shivani and Avijeet are absolutely lovely hosts, and their genuine hospitality and warm personalities effortlessly foster a sense of familiarity and comfort, making you feel like old friends.

The rooms at Aikkya Farms are aesthetically pleasing, blending rustic charm with modern comfort. One of the highlights of our stay was undoubtedly the incredible food and cocktails. We were offered a diverse and delicious array of dishes each day, each bursting with flavor and prepared with love. The staff and hosts also made sure that all our dietary preferences and tastes were taken into consideration.

The staff at Aikkya were exceptional-their dedication and attentiveness truly added to the overall experience. We still miss Shekhar ji's adrak chai!

Exploring the property itself was an absolute joy. We picked fruits for breakfast from the countless trees at the property every day- it was wonderful to reconnect with nature and enjoy the fruits of our labor, quite literally. Additionally, the property offered various treks, allowing us to explore the breathtaking surroundings. The picturesque landscapes and fresh mountain air will surely make your heart and lungs happy!

The true stars of the farm stay were the three adorable dogs that call Aikkya their home. Motu, Golu, and Julie were incredibly friendly, always eager to play and provide companionship.

This was truly an unforgettable family retreat. I highly recommend Aikkya to anyone seeking a peaceful and enriching getaway amidst the serenity of nature :)

name: Dhwani Shah
words: I will fall short of words, and can't do justice to how beautiful, wonderful and soulful this place was. It was home away from home only with a better (best) view, peace and tranquility. The location is such that you will not see another human or a home wherever your eyes travel from the room's windows or the outdoor lounge area with the valley view. The food was more than delicious and literally "Ghar ka khaana". After staying at Aikkya farms, I can wholeheartedly say that this was the best homestay experience we've had so far, truly! If you want to slow down and experience the pahaadi life, Aikkya is the place to be at. My only request is please go only if you can respect the space as your own home, the hosts and the caretakers as your family members and not expect round the clock kitchen service like a hotel or a resort. After staying here for 4 nights, we stayed at another place for 3 nights before heading back home and we felt a wee bit disappointed at the other place. That's the bar set by the Aikkya team, taken up many notches above. Thank you Shivani and Avijeet for hosting us and letting us experience the vibe at your place. It was magical. Wishing to come back soon!

name: Aditi Srivastava
words: I had an amazing time staying at Aikkya, and it is the best place to get some rest while enjoying the views! I stayed in A-frame of mind and enjoyed breathtaking views of the valley from bed. Not a bad way to spend a rainy afternoon at the hills! Shivani and Avijeet are the perfect hosts, and went above and beyond to make sure my stay was comfortable. Avijeet offered  amazing cocktails and Neeraj, the chef at property, makes brilliant food. The staff there is super friendly too. One of my best bnb experiences hands down!

name: jaskaran singh
words:
Home away from home. The place is all you need to  relax and disconnect from city life. Spacious rooms, lush green surroundings, mesmerizing valley views everything you can  ask for the place delivers.

The property is well kept by owners shivani and avijeet who gave up the city life and now put in all efforts to make sure you have a memorable holiday and stay.

The place offers 4 rooms , 3 of which are restored from old stone houses and one is an A frame. All the rooms are well equipped with all modern amenities.  The property offers you ample place to unwind and just be in the nature.

There are ample indoor games to keep the kids occupied, a short trek to nearbuy shops will address your adventure junkie.

Evening bonfire with world famous Avijeet cocktails will make you coming back for more.

They have well equipped kitchen and will serve you lip smacking kumouni meals, the owners put in all the efforts to make your stay as comfortable as possible,  the property 4 paw babies who will not leave you untill you pet them enough.

P.S : The property is made and maintained to have minimal impact on nature thus there are a lot of stairs to reach rooms as well as lounges.

name: Sameer Chaturvedi
words:
The property has an ethnic feel about it. Also, this is extremely artistically done - barely any nook/corner which does scream "Art", the moment you have a look. Rooms are spacious and comfortable. Excellent food (we had some local Kumauni delicacies also for one meal), coupled with cocktails to die for. And all of this is only further bettered by a very serene calm during the day, majestic view at the evening and a very active night gaze (there's a telescope also available for the technically sounder minds).

Also, you must find time to chat up with the amazing hosts Shivani and Avijeet.

name: Mikhil Mehra
words:
We visited Aikkya farms in the first week of May 2022, and boy oh boy, it was an absolute treat for the mind and soul.

Amidst the hilly jungles of Uttarakhand, it’s away from the city hustle bustle, yet close enough to all the basics you’d need for a comfortable stay.

We stayed both at ‘A-frame of mind’ as well as the ‘Kintsugi room’. It’s amazing how both the rooms had such a different vibe, yet being at the same property (can’t wait for the upcoming tree houses 🤫).

The place is a true labour of love, it shows how Avijeet and Shivani have put in their minds and hearts in the place. Everything is done up so thoughtfully and beautifully.

Saving the best for the last - the hosts - Avijeet and Shivani - man they’re extraordinarily sweet and warm people. Enjoyed such beautiful conversations and stories, Avijeet’s amazing breakfast and dinner preparations (surprisingly yum and instagrammable), the night safari, the ombré effect coffees, etc; glad to say we met them as guests and hosts, but came back as friends.

name: Anuj Guglani
words:
What attracted us to This place was the superhost title ...

But that's not true ... They are actually super duper Host !

Yet to come across a place or a host like them. Seems to good to be true

Avi s passion for nature and eco friendly way of life is truly inspirational. His level of selfless service is immaculate and incomparable

Shivani s communication, coordination and planning is stellar and powers the magic Avi unleashes in the hills of Sitla  ...

The cows, dogs and the cat all co habitating in harmony

The mocktails and the cocktails are a must try  which Avi prepares like an artist , all natural ingredients

The dream breakfast is truly a feast

Getting a freshly baked foccacia bread and baked eggs were truly delectable and a delightful surprise in the hills, away from ANY visible dwelling..

All I can say is "I ll be Back!"

More Power to the super duper hosts!

name: divya vyas
words:
I had been searching for a peaceful and quiet stay in Uttarakhand that would have the best views and saw about Aikkaya farms on someone’s Insta stories. There were not much reviews available that time but I had a very positive feeling about it & approached Shivani for my booking. It turned out to be great decision and my stay in as beyond my expectations. There was no hustle bustle and the view is amazing. They have great variety for food & extremely friendly staff. Luckily Avijit & Shivani both were there during my stay . Both were friendly & gracious.

I would credit the relaxed ambiance that they provided to the fact that everyone staying in their property enjoyed the evenings together.Highly recommend to friends & all !

name: DEVANSHI POWANI
words:
Treat for your senses

Tucked away in a quiet corner near Mukteshwar, this farmstay puts on display the passion and talent Avijeet and Shivani have. Enchanting location with dreamy sunsets, well designed and pleasing interiors and Avijeet's wizardry in the kitchen made for a memorable stay.
I have to talk more about Avijeet's cooking. The thought and effort behind each home cooked meal was commendable and we ended up over-eating for all of our meals. Variety of specialty coffees, herbal infusions and ginger honey tea are a treat for the soul in this weather.
Godspeed Avijeet and Shivani...

name: Budhaditya
words:
Our little holiday in Aikkya is just what our city-weary eyes and soul needed. Located on a quiet hillside with magnificent views, you can spend hours looking at the play of sun and clouds or listening to birdcall. 
Avijeet and Shivani are immaculate hosts, who went out of their way to make us comfortable. Conversation flowed easily and every meal we had was memorable. We sampled a different cuisine every day, but the pahadi meal with kumaoni chicken, bhang chutney, kaddu sabzi and raita stood out. Avijeet makes great cocktails too! 
Neeraj and Shekhar, who help around the house with cooking and cleaning, make the best chai, and are always at hand to help. 
Their dogs Julie, Motu (alias Chotu) and Golu are gentle and playful, and kept us entertained.
We are looking forward to our next visit already :)

name: Shuchi
words:
You will find many homestays in Kumaon but Aikkya farms is a home to stay in. What makes it an unforgettable experience is the warm hospitality extended by Avijeet and Shivani, ably assisted by Motu, Boltu and Shifu! 
The rooms and the lounge are super cosy and artistic, a worthy result of the effort that has gone into building this home. 
The sit out area has breathtaking views of Kumaon which makes you feel like you’re taking a walk through the clouds. The calm and peace of Aikkya rubs off on you instantly. The food is simple but diverse and lip smacking every time. Avijeet has a doctorate in making cocktails - unconventional, innovative and really hits the spot. 
Would love to be back again, we miss Motu already.

name: Neeti Popat
words:
Came across this cutest little homestay - Aikkya Farms in Seetla, Mukteshwar. We booked it via Airbnb. The service, hospitality, food and everything was top notch. The place is intricately designed so well. Great views and exceptional home cooked meals with various cuisine options
Shivani and Avijeet are immensely talented and friendly. Kudos to the work they’re doing.
Don’t miss out fun interactions with Shifu and Bolt - Their pet pals

name: Mrityunjay
words:
Thank You Shivani & Avijeet for making this natural space beautifully livable.
Its such a pristine (in its original condition) space. We lived there for a week and its the nature which absorbed us, and not we absorbing the nature. Way to understand this is, the space itself is meditative - you just have to sit there silently.
The walks / hikes we did will always be our precious memorable. Do go to Mukteshwar by hike (which is safe), its such a nature walk and one will get to understand how people use to walk in these mountains when there were no roads 50 or 100s of years ago.
Our stay became more relaxing with heartfully served meals which were healthy and pleasant and made us felt at home.
Special Thanks to Neeraj , Shekhar, Ramesh Ji for being available always for help.
Julie, Motu, Golu and Dear Cows - My daughter remembers you all regularly. Thank You for walking with us and showing us places around.
Glad To Be There At Aikkya
Mrityunjay, Shubhlekha and Manya.

name: Archana
words:
It has been one of our best holidays ever and we have only Shivani and Avijeet to thank for this. The place is beautifully designed, where every nook has been carefully decorated. It is convenient, aesthetic and artsy - the best of all worlds. It felt like home and that describes the warmth we felt with our hosts. They were helpful like friends, informative like the best of local guides, and served food and drinks that we loved. 
If Airbnb ever thinks of picking some model hosts to train the rest of them, this is the couple that can do masterclasses in being the best hosts ever. This holiday left us feeling so full, we will frequently visit every time we feel empty. 
Thank you, great cooks, photographers, musicians, best song curators, space designers, nature lovers, and thoughtful friends.

name: Bhaskar
words: Located perfectly on the hillside with picturesque views on all sides, it felt like a home away from home. Shivani, Avijeet, Shifu and Boltu are the sweetest and the kindest host’s I’ve met on Airbnb. Shivani was communicating with us from the day of the booking, the stay and till we reached home safely. Avijeet would curate the entire day’s menu keeping in mind the personal preferences of our taste buds in mind. A true testament to them being just over all brilliant hosts. Their home has been very tastefully designed and constructed by the lovely couple. Every corner of the property reflects their mindset of being Aikkya with nature. It is the perfect place for WFH or just unwinding/chilling. The sunsets are spectacular (yes the sunset photograph on the page is real and not photoshopped, although choose the time of the year carefully cz there can be controlled forest fires by the local administration which may hinder the view) and the full moon nights are only dreamier. It’s the perfect place to leave the noise and troubles of life behind. I saw pictures of the place in the wintertime…

name: gaurav choudhary
words:
Aikkya isn’t just a stay—it’s an experience that slows you down and grounds you. Tucked away in the peaceful lap of nature near Mukteshwar, this boutique farm stay is where thoughtful design meets raw simplicity. The cottages are warm, earthy, and beautifully curated with local aesthetics, making you feel right at home, yet away from everything.

The property is intimate, not crowded, and that's its charm. You wake up to birdsong, sip coffee with the sun rising over the valley, and end your day stargazing around a bonfire. The food is fresh, local, and soul-satisfying—exactly what you'd want in the mountains.

But what truly sets Aikkya apart is the intention behind everything. You can feel that this place was created with heart—with nature, sustainability, and mindfulness in mind.

If you're looking for a serene, offbeat retreat to reconnect with yourself or simply take a break from city chaos, Aikkya is the kind of place you'll keep coming back to.

name: Leon
words: Aikkya Farms is an awesome place to stay in serenity and close to nature away from all hustle, if you love a good home cook food, the host will treat you like friends and family, sunset views which will keep you mesmerised. The short hikes around the property are just awesome not tiring and give you a great view from the top. Hiking up to the Sitla market was awesome, as we were guided by Molto and Julie along with 2 fur babies shifu and boltu that will only ask for  belly rubs in return. My wife , myself and our fur baby loved the vibe in the common area and sitting outside star gazing, by the way it's a great place to spot shooting stars and if you're lucky a UAP 😁. Avi and Shivani were sweet enough to arrange a cake for my wife's birthday which was very tasty, thank you once again for that. Overall we loved our stay so much that for sure whenever we are back, we will stay at Aikkya

name: Arjun Mukherjee
words:
We stayed at this place during December 2025. Initially the thought was that since it was up in the hills, the accommodation would be cold. However, we were pleasantly surprised to find that the rooms were not only exceptionally well done but also very well insulated and cozy. The view in the morning is fantastic, especially if you choose to have your breakfast outside and if one dares there’s also a makeshift small trek to a few shops up the road.
The staff is friendly and the fellow who cooks deserves a round of applause for keeping the meals as close to a “home away from home” experience.

The hosts, (insert names) are very accommodating and warm people who are constantly making sure that you’re having a worthwhile experience at the farm stay. The hosts also include notably 4 dogs who’ll accompany you all over the premises till they feel you’re settled in.

Overall, it was a wonderful stay and would highly recommend it to folks looking for a quick getaway from the city life.

name: Nakul
words:
Words fall short for such a wonderful and comfortable stay at Aikkya Farms. 
Avijeet and Shivani are perhaps the most thoughtful hosts who always give a personal touch to almost everything possible, be it their home cooked food, to unbelievably delicious cocktails (Jamun flavoured one specially). We've stayed in multiple Airbnb's up in the hills but this one stands out, hands down. 
The location is easily accessible, rooms are delightful, very choicefully done, specially Kintsugi stone cottage. Attention to finer details is what makes this place so memorable. 
You get 24hrs hot water supply, electric blankets make the cold bearable even during 0 degrees, bonfire with a view, spick and span bathrooms with a roof view, to name a few!
And if you're a dog lover then you're in for a treat, Shifu, Bolt, Julie, Motu and Golu make you not want to leave the property and just soak in the sun while you play with them. 
Undoubtedly a 5/5 to these wonderful people and their property. 
Cheers guys, keep up the awesome work.

name: meetu kohli
words: Couldn’t ask for a better getaway ( 8 nights) to experience the best food, awesome cocktails, perfect hosts and above all the most chilled out place ever. The sunsets are to die for over hot toddy s and home made mulled wine! Shivani n Avi, our hosts have the most beautiful energy and treat everyone like family and their home is just as warm and friendly as them. We have definitely found our second home in the hills! And yes, the electric blankets in the rooms ( for Dec and Jan weather) is so lovely that one gets the best sleep ever!

name: Akansha
words:
Been traveling to mountains for years now but Aikkya is something else. Buried in time yet modern & cosy. Beautiful location, amazing view, secluded yet accessible, interiors are breathtaking especially the lounge, great food & service.
Full of loving dogs Motu, Julie & Golu, it’s a heaven for pet parents, dogs are genuinely welcome here without 100 rules. But what truly makes this place special is its hosts’ attention to details. Every corner of Aikkya has been carefully done and reeks of love. When I went to Aikkya I felt I am going to someone’s home and after spending two days there I started to feel like I know the people who have created this space  (and that’s when I didn’t even meet them),  because every inch of Aikkya speaks of them. They have poured their hearts in this place and it really shows. The balance of creative feminine energy and secure & safe masculine energy makes this place a beautiful safe heaven.
Shivani and Avijeet are the best hosts ever.
Gem, this place.

name: Vanya
words:
So first things first, Aikyya’s location is superb and it recommends itself really well for a peaceful getaway. The sunset views are beautiful! 
About the room (Kintsugi), it’s fairly big and clean. I loved how thoughtfully it’s been put together by the hosts. They have added little decor elements that make the room stand out. A big thumbs up for the electric blankets which will be your saviour on extremely cold Mukteshwar nights. Not to forget, the meals prepared here are delicious. 
Now for the issues we faced - there was a day long powercut when we arrived at the property and that took a little away from our experience. However, it’s a farmstay and these things, though rare, can happen. Again, I’d like to mention that Shivani managed the situation quite well, given the circumstances. 
What we did miss was meeting the hosts (having heard about them from the reviews and other guests) . Perhaps another time! :)
Overall, I’d recommend the place in a heartbeat.

name: Anuj
words:
What attracted us to This place was the superhost title ...
But that's not true ... They are actually super duper Host !
Yet to come across a place or a host like them. Seems to good to be true 
Avi s passion for nature and eco friendly way of life is truly inspirational. His level of selfless service is immaculate and incomparable
Shivani s communication, coordination and planning is stellar and powers the magic Avi unleashes in the hills of Sitla  ...
The cows, dogs and the cat all co habitating in harmony  
 
The mocktails and the cocktails are a must try  which Avi prepares like an artist , all natural ingredients
The dream breakfast is truly a feast 
Getting a freshly baked foccacia bread and baked eggs were truly delectable and a delightful surprise in the hills, away from ANY visible dwelling..
All I can say is "I ll be Back!" 
More Power to the super duper hosts!

name: Abhishek Pradhan
words:
Just got back from a stay at Aikkya Farms and honestly, I’m still daydreaming about it.
It’s this beautiful farmhouse tucked away in the forest on a hill, completely peaceful, surrounded by trails, and the sunsets are unreal.
The dogs there are the absolute best they welcome you like you’re part of the pack! It just instantly feels like home.
And then there’s Avijeetda and Shibani, the sweetest hosts ever. Avijeetda’s cooking and his cocktails? Next level! Every meal felt like a treat, and evenings with good drinks and mountain air were just perfect.
It’s the kind of place where you forget about your phone, go on long walks, read, chill, and just breathe. If you’re looking to unwind and feel human again, just go to Aikkya Farms!

name: Aakriti
words: Had such a lovely stay at Shivani and Avijeet's place. We were looking for a peaceful getaways from Gurgaon for the long weekend and we could not have asked for a better place. This was everything we were looking for, peaceful surroundings, greenery, beautiful valley and sunset view. We had the company of two loving and friendliest doggos - Julie and Motu. Shivani and Avijeet have really put in a lot of thought into creating this place, right from the concept of the place to designing the cottages. They are such super nice hosts, they made our stay very very comfortable, they were super responsive. Initially we were worried that the way to the place would may have been impacted by heavy rains/ landslides but we did not face any difficulty reaching the place, infact we would 100% recommend booking this place during monsoons to witness the beautiful valley and sunset views.

name: Shyamak
words:
Avijeet and Shivani's Aikkya in Sheetla is a must stay place, if you are looking for a quiet time in the serenity of the hills. The cottages have been tastefully and aesthetically designed to give you the maximum of the mountain beauty. Aikkya is located in Sheetla on the sides of a mountain, amidst orchards of plums and apricots and a seamless view of the mountains, clouds and greens. If you are looking to rewind and recover, do visit this place. 
Avijeet had been a great host, friend and guide. He has built this place with lots of passion and toil. His love and efforts shows in the kind of reception and warmth he shares with each of his guests, including us. And most of all, its pet friendly. So our four legged baby had most of the fun. 
Thanks again to Avijeet and Shivani for hosting us.

name: Neha
words:
We had a wonderful holiday at Aikkya. We stayed in Kintsugi & the place was gorgeous. 
1) The entire place is so beautifully done. It could feel the love & effort made to build & keep the place so amazing. Small lil things here & there - beautiful, funny & classy.
2) It was all spic & span- the cottage as well as the place. 
3) The views - specially sunset are magnificent. We went in monsoon season- it was absolutely gorgeous.
4) Food is amazing.
5) The entire staff is absolutely brilliant. Always smiling & wonderful in services.
7) I couldn’t meet Shivani because we had to rush back but it was wonderful talking to her over the phone. My heartfelt thanks to Avijit for showing us the place when we arrived & making us feel absolutely comfortable:) 
Thank you Aikkya ♥️

name: Shreya Sarawagi
words:
We visited Aikkya with our family, including our adorable but reactive dog. The hosts were warm and inviting and made us feel like family. They went out of their way and even leashed their dog so ours would be comfortable. It was easy losing track of time just having conversations with Shivani and Avijeet.

The staff was very courteous and the Thai and Kumaoni food was to die for. We were also impressed by the cocktails.

If you plan to stay here, note that this is for people looking for peace and quiet and a break from city life. (Don't start partying or playing loud music in the forest, no one wants that!) It was relaxing enough that we didn't leave the premises for 2 days. It's a great place to wind down, take walks and hang with their super friendly dogs.

A quick note: they do have steep stairs (it's on a hill) so you might want to keep that in mind if travelling with the elderly.

name: Pujarini
words: We had a lovely stay. It's apparent that it's a new establishment and there's some work to be done — some we witnessed while there. Nonetheless, the experience was wonderful. It's very conveniently located, and in a very scenic and beautiful spot. The IVRI forest is nearby and makes for a beautiful drive. You can enjoy some beautiful sunsets with a warm cuppa or a cocktail that the hosts will make for you if they are around. You can bake your own cakes if you're celebrating (we did) and the Avijeet cooks/bakes wonderfully as well. There are lots of adorable furry friends around, so if you're a dog lover, you'll love it. Lots of beautiful hikes around and Mukteshwar is also only a short drive away and has some great, small food options. Highly recommend, would visit again :)

name: Brooke
words: I cannot say enough positive things about this farmstay and the folks who run it (Avijeet, you’re the best host!) I came with four people and we rented Kintsugi and the A-frame and had a cozy, restful and beautiful stay. Everything is designed so well and the food/drinks are delicious—but more importantly Avijeet and the kind folks he’s hired to work with him are so hospitable that you’ll feel like you don’t want to leave. The property is gorgeous and we went on a beautiful day hike through the local villages, had lunch with a local family and spent the rest of the time exploring the property, and hanging in the evenings by the cozy fireplace with the sweetest dogs. We left feeling completely relaxed, warm and inspired. Keep it up, guys! We’ll be back.

name: Sahib
words:
Fabulous location, ensconced in the woods of sorts, tucked away yet accessible, jaw-dropping vistas, comfortable and tastefully done room, and a charming host.
The food was EXCELLENT. Fresh, high quality ingredients, cooked to perfection with our host leaving his indelible flavory mark on each dish. Coffee hit all the right spots too. 
What sets Aikkya apart is the attention to detail, the care taken by our host to ensure we have a one-of-a-kind experience (his trail recommendations for the few hikes we did were superb), warm and friendly staff, and little things like the choice of subtle fixtures in the cafe/dining area, garden lights, elegant cane furniture, model vintage motor bikes placed on a window sill, .... I could go on. 
Kumaon has its very own Garden of Eden. We will be returning soon!

name: Gaurav Mittal
words: We have just checked out from Aikkya and oh boy what a home it has become for the four of us !!!! We have had one of a very relaxing stays here with the most sumptuous meals and out of the world cocktails made by Avijeet!!!! Our heart wants more of it and we are just looking at the holiday calendar to book ourselves again in the coming summer to see and experience for ourselves the change in the fauna. Our kids bonded very well with Shivani and her four dogs and they were ready to stay back even without us . This in itself should be a compliment to the hosts Shivani and Avijeet !!!Yeh dil maangey more

name: Prajnay
words:
A Slice of Serenity in the Mountains!
We recently spent a week at Shivani and Avijeet’s beautiful Airbnb, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience. Tucked away in the mountains, the location offers a serene and peaceful environment that was perfect for a relaxing getaway.
Shivani and Avijeet were incredible hosts, always warm and welcoming. Their friendliness truly enhanced our stay, with engaging conversations that made us feel right at home. A special mention goes to the food—Avijeet really gave it a personal touch. There was a wide variety of options, each one better than the last. We were never disappointed!
Without a doubt, this stay ranks among our top Airbnb experiences, and we would highly recommend their place to anyone looking for a perfect mountain escape.

name: Suniva
words:
Our stay at Aikkya Farms in Kumaon was truly unforgettable! Nestled in a stunning location, the serene views and peaceful ambiance made for the perfect getaway. The cottages are beautifully designed with heating amenities that ensured we were cozy and comfortable throughout our stay.
Shivani and Avijeet are exceptional hosts who go above and beyond to make guests feel at home. Their warmth and attention to detail truly elevated the experience. The food was absolutely delicious, with every meal thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor—a true treat!
This has been one of the best stays we’ve ever had, and we can’t recommend it enough to anyone looking for a perfect mountain retreat. We’re already looking forward to returning someday!

name: vivek taterway
words:
We booked it as just a stop over on our way to Binsar. And like every traveller would know random and at the spur of moment decisions often turn out to be most amazing experience of a trip.
Shivani and Avijeet and their babies ( 4 legged ones) made it a memorable stay for us.
It was an afternoon, evening, night of fun and talks and banter. An amazing stay we had .. parents, two babies under 5 and four other adults.
Avijeet made kick ass cocktails, there was only one more family staying who were equally sport.

We had a great time and memories for a lifetime.

Vivek ( from Fiji)

name: Princey Mittal
words: Our stay at Aikkya was like living in screensavers. The view, the food and the people are all so heartwarming. Aikkya lounge and our kintsugi room were our home away from home for this dreamy holiday. Time literally stops at Aikkya and I forgot my phone in bag, that's why so less pictures. Just kept absorbing nature, the bird songs, the beautiful landscape and our time with the dogs here. Shifu, boltu, motu and julie only love n play. The hosts shivani and avijeet will spoil you with their warmth, worlds best cocktails and food options. Best home stay holiday destination !!

name: Ayush
words:
This is one amazing Airbnb in Seethla (near Mukteshwar). The location was easy to find, the hosts are amazing and the place has some very cute doggos who would wake us up in the morning and walk with us to the lounge. 
Extremely quiet and beautiful property with some amazing interiors done in the rooms and the perfect lounge area. We met the host Avijeet who's an amazing person to talk to in general and makes sure you have an amazing stay. As a bonus, he makes some kickass cocktails too. Michelin star food is available at very reasonable rates making it the perfect Airbnb. A must recommend from my side.

name: Neelaksh
words:
Avijeet and Shivani run one of the nicest most peaceful stays one can experience. They make you feel right at home. 
Avijeet and Neeraj bhai run a tight ship in the kitchen. They are great cooks who create with passion and will make sure that your palette also gets the refreshing taste that it deserves. If you’re lucky you’ll find freshly made plum, apricot jams and chutneys too at the property too (they are all sourced from the farm)! Ask for Gin-Jeera cocktail on a sunny Seetla afternoon and thank me later. 
Special shout-out to Julie, bolt, shifu, Golu, and motu for being the best doggos

name: Trupthi
words:
Shivani and Avijeet are the most thoughtful and friendly hosts one can stay with. We spent our new years at Aikkya and couldn't have asked for better company or experience. It is a quiet spot in Seetla with great views. The rooms are extremely comfortable even in the winter with all the listed amenities available.
The food at Aikkya is delicious, homely and diverse so suitable for long stays. We enjoyed sitting in the sun room and reading on cold winter mornings and walking around the mountains. There are also some good restaurants a hike away from the property.

name: Nishant Singh Dahiya
words: Beautiful property to stay at with family and friends. Located at a very prime location with amazing view of the mountains and easily accessible. Sunsets are extremely beautiful everyday. Hosts are very humble and helpful. All the rooms are very clean and nicely decorated. Food is delicious and do try the host's special cocktails. Best ones we ever had! Had a fantastic stay.

name: Jai
words:
Just returned from our stay at Aikkya Farm, and I'm happy to report it lives up to the glowing reviews. My partner, our 11-month-old, our Golden Retriever, and I really enjoyed our time there. The place is just as others have described, with Shivani and Avijeet's efforts clearly reflected in the charming ambiance they've created.
The food, however, truly stood out. Avijeet's cocktails are exceptional, and the trout served on our last night was the highlight of our trip. It’s clear a lot of care and passion goes into their hospitality. We’re definitely looking forward to another visit.

name: Pratham
words:
We’ve stayed at a whole bunch of air bnbs and this one is right on top. The views are amazing, the sun room is perfect , the rooms inside are cozy luxurious hipster rolled up in one. The detailing is exquisite, you can spend a day just spotting little wonders in the design. 
The hosts are kind, warm , fun and are genuinely there to delight you. 
It’s private with spots for community fun. 
Highlight apart from the great everything else was the living room with all those musical instruments. 
Thanks for hosting us Shivani and avi

name: Aaron
words:
Couldn’t have been more pleased.
This is a gorgeous remote mountain retreat 
Their is a fantastic on-site kitchen that provided lovely meals that catered to what we needed (I was unwell and they made me better) 
Stunning walks to see the monkeys. Room for yoga and quiet reading. A projector to watch movies at night. Warm with electric blanket and running hot water. 
The hosts extremely accommodating. Worked around our schedule and always on hand to answer questions and help. 
Would definitely recommend. A great excursion away from traditional tourist routes. Loved it

name: Toshi Vasistha
words:
ok, me and my husband have been traveling together for more than 5 years now and we have NEVER found a single place like this one. The view from this place is outstanding.
This boutique stay has been built up from start by Avijeet and Shivani. Lovers. One of the most talented folks I have met. Every single design, nook, and corner has been created by them.

Beautiful designs. I am staying in kintsugi, it's a Japanese word. Meaning: art of repairing broken pottery by mending the areas of breakage with lacquer dusted or mixed with powdered gold, silver, or platinum;

So, they have restored the eighty-year-old old Kumaoni stone Home. You would fall in love with this place, love with this place is like love at first sight and it keeps growing only.

The owners are sweethearts.
Avijeet is a great cook and their hospitality is top-notch.
This place is a 7 hours drive from Gurgaon. If you really want to try something unique and you love mountains, then don't wait and book this place.

I am surely going to come back here!!! :) Thank you guys for creating this gorgeous stay.

name: Jasjit
words:
It was a great break from the city, We stayed in Sabi, a few extra steps to climb, but worth every bit. The place overall is very well designed and makes you feel happy being there. For birders, you would not need to step out as there is big variety visiting the farm itself. 
Shivani and Avijeet are great hosts and made it special. Delicious food and cocktails churned up by Avijeet every evening added to the interesting conversations with hosts and other guests. Thanks Shivani and Avijeet for having us over.

name: Abhishek
words: Avjeet and Shivani's place is a quiet hideout in the hills, away from the sound of cars and humanity. Ur animal friends are more than welcome too. Avjeet is a great host, always busy with making ur stay better. We did move around quite a bit so didn't get to fully enjoy the peace of the place. The property has a few dogs, who are friendly and not intrusive. It's a bit of a climb from the parking lot but that'll only do good. Wud love to stay again

name: Nikhita
words:
This was possibly one of our best short trips. The location is perfect for unwinding and is best for getting some peace away from the city. Loved the rustic, boho chic vibe of the cottage. Very pretty. 
The best part was our host Avijeet, he made us feel super comfortable. He was so helpful in finding the place, the check-in process and he cooked amazing meals both days, continental and Thai. This was a cherry on the cake. 
Really loved this trip. Would be definitely going back soon!

name: Killol
words:
Avijeet and Shivani have painstakingly built Aikkya farms, with minute attention to detail given to restoring stone and wood cottages, as well as building an A-frame from scratch. Lots of Japanese and Scandinavian design influence, executed tastefully! They welcome you in and treat you like a family member. We were there during plum and peach harvest season and enjoyed the fruits to our heart's content. I would book again without hesitation!
P.S. - if you're into cocktails, Avijeet is a fantastic mixologist - ask for a "Jeerum" :-)

name: Smriti
words: Every corner of this home was like a breath of fresh air right from the beautiful done room to home theatre room with a sun roof to glaze at the stars to a huge, cosy, fun kitchen and common area where there was so much to explore. It's a private Home built away from chaos and it's so serene to just sit and have a bonfire or play with the dogs at the property. Had a peaceful, warm, much needed quiet and cosy getaway here.

name: Rajeev
words: Shivani and Avijeet's place is exactly as described , clean ,well kept and in a quiet corner of seetla..perfect for a relaxing retreat.Shivani was very prompt with her responses and they always try and acomodate any of your requests.The food is also very good..i literally tried everything off the menu and it never dissapointed.And the cocktails by Avijeet...everything else aside..im definitely coming back to try more of these!Overall a great place to stay , great hosts and hope to come back another time!

name: Khyati
words:
Shivani and Avijeet are great hosts! 
We stayed at the Kintsugi cottage for 2 days and the experience was great!
On the day of arrival, Shivani was coordinating with us the entire time and made sure that we have everything we need.
During the stay, Avijeet made an amazing dinner suiting both of our palate. His Thai curry was probably the best we have had.
We would definitely want to come back for the view, the quaintness, the food, and the conversation.

name: Prashant
words: We had an amazing time while staying at Aikkya. The place is as beautiful as it's shown in the pictures. The best part of the whole property for us was the rooms and dining area, is it done so tastefully. Although host were not there during our visit but their staff was very good and helpful. Neeraj is a really good Chef and made superb meals for us. I would highly recommend the place.

name: Priya
words: It was an extremely warm and lovely stay. Shivani and Avijeet hosted us very well with every need being catered to and an extremely friendly vibe. All the meals we had were different and extremely sumptuous. They suggested places to go around and all of them were great. An extremely quaint and beautiful place to be if you are looking for a nice relaxing weekend with some amazing views!

name: Antesh
words:
This is undoubtedly one of the best holiday experiences that me and my family had. Everything is so great about the place - location, rooms, food and more importantly hospitality by Avijeet and Shivani. 
Avijeet was such a great host that he even prepared such a lovely grilled fish, after knowing that both me and my son love fish. 
We will surely be back to this amazing property.

name: Tejaswi
words: We had a lovely stay at Aikkya. Avijeet was personally present to attend to our needs and also keen to offer recommendations,  experiences and stories. The food was fresh, clean and yumm. It's evident that the hosts have personally invested a lot of time, love and labour into making this bnb. The three dogs Julie, Golu and Chhotu made our stay even more memorable.

name: Jiggya
words: Avijeet is a fabulous host, we had a fantastic stay. Avijeet makes special efforts to make sure his guests have a great time. The space is like a dream, picturesque views, peaceful surroundings, and outstanding company. The food was tasty yet homely. Do ask Avijeet to mix a jaljeera cocktail when you visit. All in all a great stay. Loved it!

name: Arup Banerjee
words: If you are looking for a place in the hills to get the real feel of the hills then look no further than Aikkya by Avijeet and Shivani! Great location (no neighbours nearby by design according to Avijeet), thoughtfully designed, great food, attentive staff and super warm hosts. We have done many hills stays but this one is right on top!

name: Parul
words: Thanks Avijeet and Shivani for a very nice stay, food and conversations. Avantika and I enjoyed the little things such as the midnight safari, meeting Julie, aulie and their pups, the rimjhim cocktails, the sun deck and what not. Being a girls trip, we felt safe and had a great time overall. Thanks!

name: Anshul
words: We visited the place with our Labrador  and we were welcomed right at home. The place is a gem , you will get to view the most magical  sunsets and  poetic landscape ,  and the best part is you will feel right at home. Thank you Shivani Avijeet Shekar Neeraj for the hospitality

name: Kirti
words: Don't think just book! this place is Uttrakhand's best kept secret. Avijeet & Shivani are wonderful hosts and if you appreciate good design their is good design everywhere you look, the place is so aesthetic. If you love good food, you will leave this place with your eyes, stomachs and hearts full.

name: Kuldeep
words:
Aikkya farms is a love affair amidst nature. Shivani and Avijeet are extremely gracious hosts, always responsive. They also serve delicious food along with some amazing cocktails. They have 4 dogs who are super friendly.
It’s a beautiful place to unwind, relax and enjoy solitude. Definitely visiting this wonderful place soon.

name: Malavika
words: This was truly one of the best vacations me and my husband have had in a while. Aikkya farms is a great place to decompress, with great views, cute dogs, delicious food and lovely humans. We couldn't have asked for better hosts. Would definitely go back again and again!

name: Vishal
words: The place is amazing and it reeks of Avijeet's free and artistic spirit. The room was comfortable and the washroom clean. Food was lip smacking. Shivani and Avijeet have done a great job in providing a memorable experience to their guests. Will visit again for sure.

name: Rahul
words: Shivani and Avijeet have created an incredible space in the mountains, and it is generous of them to let people in. It’s simple, high on minimalist aesthetic, perfect for a restorative getaway. And the food is great too. Would highly recommend it.

name: Sunny
words: We stayed at Aikkya for 2 days and it is such an amazing place ! The location is very beautiful . The food was very nice. Avijeet and Shivani are very humble and helpful. We really had a great time :)

name: Himanshu
words: One of the finest places we have experienced. Serene, elegant, very tastefully done up. Avijeet & Shivani's passion for design echoes throuought the property. A wonderful place to unwind, share stories and experience Zen in the middle of the mountains.
